summary: High-quality TypeScript/Bun implementation with strong typing, custom error classes, and clear separation of concerns. Workflow properly uses pinned action refs and least-privilege perms. Minor issues: (1) Bun install via curl is not version-pinned (workflow lines ~9, ~20–could use an action or pin hash); (2) Bun install duplicated across jobs (acceptable for clarity but could factor to composite action); (3) workflow assumes fixtures/scenario.json exists (intentional for test harness but means standalone runs fail—this is by design). Code is exceptionally readable with WHY-focused comments (applyInclude semantics especially clear). Error handling is solid with custom exception types. No dead code or overengineering detected.
